## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3 and 6: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, and
`ocr/06/articles-report.md` for `folded`. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 14/3 specifics

- Located 91.7% (17.7% by fuzzy match), label + body 85.4%, analysis 59.6% (re-run 25 Sep with the fixes of brief §27).
- No typed witness covers this book (Pn Daza's copy has 255 of its headwords, without pages).
- **Eight runs of headwords are printed a page later than the index files them**: the unindexed pp. 402, 565, 625, 930, 936, 962 (and, weaker, 605, 976) each begin entries with the unlocated headwords of the page before. And on pp. 564, 607, 620 the next page's list scores higher than the page's own. Six are now in `ID_PAGE_FIX` (402, 565, 625, 930, 936, 962; brief §27); 605 and 976 wait for an image check. Located 91.1% → 91.7%.
- The last hundred pages score 69%: p. 1104 (2 of 14) reads ပ္လ as ဖ/ဒိ.

## Spot check

One page, p. 580 (a page near the middle of the book with 9–14 headwords): **image**: 9 of 10 at the right entry, 1 unlocated (ပိညာက), none wrong; labels 8 right, 1 not read (ပိဉ္ဆ, placed inside its own article).
Checked on the page image.
For this batch the spot check is one page per book, not three: vols. 10–19 are checked page by page against the typed witness instead, and the three books without one (14/3, 20, 22) on the image.
